t: Patio, wall and roof sealer provides a clear, protective barrier designed for safeguarding outdoor mineral surfaces. Ideal for trade professionals and DIYers working on external brickwork, concrete paths and roof tiles, the formula forms a durable barrier to prevent water infiltration, freeze and thaw damage, and algae growth. Deep-penetrating liquid can be used on both vertical and horizontal surfaces, and applies easily with a brush or roller, maintaining the natural appearance of the substrate without altering its colour. Low-odour, solvent-free composition. 2 coats deliver comprehensive coverage of up to 8m² per litre, drying in 1-2 hours to secure long-lasting weather resistance. Suitable for use on all porous mineral materials. Supplied in a 5Ltr container.
